items.title: [CCE] One People, One Pen: Essay Competition on Racial & Religious Harmony
items.author: Tay Lay Keow, June
items.description:
✍️ One People, One Pen: Essay Competition on Racial & Religious Harmony
Got strong opinions and a way with words? OnePeople.sg Model UN wants to hear them.
Why join?
🏆 $100 in vouchers up for grabs ($50 1st, $30 2nd, $20 3rd)
📜 High Distinction, Distinction & Commendation awards, plus a certificate for every valid entry
📰 Get featured. Winning essays may be posted so your ideas reach a wider audience
🧠 Skills that transfer to the research, argumentation and persuasive writing skills that matter for GP, Humanities subjects and scholarship essays
The details
Entries: 1 per participant, choose 1 of 5 questions
Deadline: 1 November 2026, 2359 hrs
Submission form:
https://forms.gle/QJPzcsy268GJofU4A
One entry, one question, one chance to have your voice heard. Start writing today!
For any enquiries please contact: opmunprojects@gmail.com
